# Test fixtures

Small, reviewable golden vectors live here. Each fixture identifies its upstream version, inputs, expected outputs, and generator provenance. No personal save data is stored.

`skill_stream_v0.9.3.json` was generated by executing the upstream web calculator's `app.js` RNG and skill mapping functions at commit `c37b67d3d21d6b1c3318c8b6394e1c776dc876c3`. It covers the upstream sample, zero seed/counter, the upper documented base-seed bound with a nontrivial counter, and the pre-threshold counter-gate path.
